title: A group/summary row presents its rolled-up totals as an inline math strip
refs: SV-8593 (SBC spec v20 2026-08-17; grouped-totals math strip per Chris Ward design review 2026-08-17; exact styling to confirm live)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A report with group/summary rows is open (for example Sales By Customer, whose customer and asset rows roll up their invoices).
steps:
1. Find a group/summary row that rolls up several child rows (a customer row over its assets and invoices).
2. Read the rolled-up values shown on that group row, including the Labor Delta total.
expected:
1. A group/summary row shows its rolled-up column totals (the sum across its child rows), including the Labor Delta total, in the same column positions and formats as a data row.
2. Those rolled-up totals are presented together as a compact inline "math strip" on the group row - the design-review treatment for grouped totals.
3. Confirm live against the design/build: the exact visual layout of the "math strip" (spacing, separators, whether the operator/equals signs are shown) is described only in the design review - confirm the exact presentation live before pinning it; do not invent the layout.
4. Note for the tester: the rolled-up numbers themselves must tie out to the sum of the child rows; only the visual "math strip" styling is what this case is confirming.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, the reporting-shell story SV-8593, and Chris Ward's design-review decisions of 17 August 2026 (the grouped-totals math strip). The Sales By Customer report specification version 20 does not name this visual treatment, so the exact styling is Loom-sourced and is marked for live confirmation above (read on 17 August 2026).
Last checked against build v3.8-2bf8d14 on 8/18/2026.
